name: Kuta Town Center & Kuta Beach
tagline: The walkable heart of it all
description: The compact hub where most nomads base themselves, lined with cafes, warungs, surf shops, guesthouses, and rental outfits, all within a short walk of Kuta beach. It offers the town's best mix of services, food, and social life, plus easy scooter access to every outer bay.
bestFor: First-timers and nomads who want cafes, food, and services close by
pros: Walkable to cafes, shops, and the beach
Best concentration of services and food
Easy launch point for the outer bays
cons: Busiest and noisiest part of town
Central beach is less pristine than outer bays

name: Mandalika & the Road to Tanjung Aan
tagline: Postcard bays and the MotoGP circuit
description: East of town, this coastal stretch runs past the Mandalika development and the MotoGP circuit toward Tanjung Aan, one of the area's most beautiful white-sand bays. It is more spread out and scenic, blending resort-scale projects with jaw-dropping, calmer swimming beaches reached by scooter.
bestFor: Beach lovers who want stunning sand and calmer swimming
pros: Access to gorgeous Tanjung Aan bay
Quieter and more spacious than the center
Big scenery and event energy on race weekends
cons: Spread out and car or scooter dependent

name: Selong Belanak
tagline: The beginner-surf bay to the west
description: A wide, gently curving white-sand bay west of Kuta, famous for mellow beginner-friendly waves and surf schools. It is calmer and more low-key than the town center, with beach warungs and a few stays, drawing surfers learning the ropes and travelers after a laid-back, scenic base.
pros: Ideal gentle waves for learning to surf
cons: A scooter drive from Kuta town center

name: Gerupuk
tagline: The surf-break village to the east
description: A small fishing and surf village east of Kuta, set on a sheltered bay with several reef breaks reached by short boat rides. It is quieter and more local than the center, popular with committed surfers who want reliable waves, simple homestays, and an authentic, low-key village feel.
bestFor: Dedicated surfers chasing consistent reef breaks
cons: Very limited cafes and nomad amenities
Best waves need a boat to reach
